summary: The `ansible.builtin.file` module sets attributes of files, directories, and symlinks or removes them. Many modules such as copy, template, and assemble share its options; use win_file on Windows.
questions: How do I change permissions or ownership on an existing file?
How do I delete a file or directory with Ansible?
Which module manages files on Windows?
Do copy and template support the same options as file?

answer_card.title: file module overview
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.file` sets attributes of files, directories, or symlinks and their targets, or removes files, symlinks, or directories. Many other modules, including `copy`, `template`, and `assemble`, support the same options. For Windows targets use `ansible.windows.win_file`.
